emerging_technology: NPU-accelerated on-device AI inference on edge-computing laptops
intended_application: Evaluate locally running speech transcription and document summarization on employee laptops during field visits with unreliable internet; staff review and correct all outputs.
business_need: Help technicians document visits while offline and reduce time spent rewriting notes.
users_stakeholders: Field technicians, customers, service managers, IT administrators, security and procurement
capabilities_constraints: Assume the company manages its current laptop fleet and can supply a small pilot group; actual laptop specifications, model availability, application compatibility and acquisition costs are unknown. Use synthetic or consented test material initially.
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect summaries could omit safety-critical details; stolen laptops, model downloads or unintended network transfers could expose customer information. Staff retain responsibility for service records and equipment decisions.
management_question: Should management include NPU-equipped laptops and local AI software in its 2027 replacement cycle, and which evidence would justify a limited pilot?
time_horizon: 2027 procurement decision; bounded pilot before any fleet-wide commitment
additional_context: Hypothetical case prepared 2026-11-16 for a prospective 2027 decision; organizational details, proposed triggers and 2027 circumstances are assumptions, not observed outcomes. Conventional baseline: existing laptops with human note-taking and approved cloud transcription or summarization when connected. Complementary dependencies: compatible local models and applications, device management, encryption, update controls and documented offline behavior. Proposed monitoring: IT lead reviews quarterly and at procurement milestones; compare local and cloud workflows on representative consented recordings using pre-agreed measures for transcription accuracy, omission rates, latency, battery life, offline availability, support burden and total cost. Reassess if the local workflow meets those thresholds, or if software support, security findings or pricing materially change. Hype-sensitive assertion to test, not a fact: an NPU automatically makes every AI workflow private, faster and less expensive.
